Definition
[distance coordinates]

Source: petersen:page-0219 ↗ cor:pet-ch5-uniform-injectivity-radius-compact

Fix $p\in M$ and $U i p$ with $B(q,\operatorname {inj}(q))\supset U$ for all $q\in U$; then $r_q(x)=|xq|$ is smooth on $U-\{ q\} $ for each $q\in U$. Choosing $q_1,\dots ,q_n\in U-\{ p\} $, $n=\dim M$, with $ abla r_{q_1}(p),\dots , abla r_{q_n}(p)$ linearly independent, the inverse function theorem makes $\varphi =(r_{q_1},\dots ,r_{q_n})$ coordinates near $p$.
